result.summary: A free kick is taken from outside the box, struck over the defensive wall. The goalkeeper makes a save, and the subsequent rebound is cleared by the defending team.

observations.title: Free kick setup
observations.body: The play begins with a free kick being set up. Players from both teams are positioning themselves, with the defending team forming a wall and the attacking team placing players in the box.

observations.title: Defensive wall formation
observations.body: The defending team has a wall of players in dark kits positioned to block the free kick. They are organized to cover a portion of the goal.

observations.title: Free kick delivery
observations.body: A player in a white kit takes the free kick, striking the ball towards the goal. The ball travels over the defensive wall.

observations.title: Goalkeeper save
observations.body: The goalkeeper, wearing a yellow kit, reacts to the shot and makes a save. The ball is pushed away from the goal.

observations.title: Rebound and follow-up attempt
observations.body: The ball rebounds into the penalty area after the save. An attacking player in a white kit attempts to reach the ball for a follow-up shot.

observations.title: Defensive clearance
observations.body: A defender in a dark kit successfully clears the ball out of the penalty area. This action removes the immediate danger from the goal.
